//: Typecheck the TypeScript pages-build owns: the Sandpack demo fixtures and
the docs components (plan 195 item 5c, widened 2026-08-21).
WHY THIS EXISTS. pages-build's check chain is lint + astro build +
link-check, and `astro build` bundles standalone .ts/.tsx WITHOUT
type-checking it. So `demoUsers.ts` kept `plan: { id }` for months after the
field was renamed to `handle` — the file even closed with
`satisfies Record<DemoUserId, DemoUser>`, so the types were right and
applied; nothing ever RAN them. The next docs deploy would have installed a
current SDK into every Sandpack sandbox and denied every entitlement check
in every live demo.
SCOPE — galleries are excluded, deliberately. `src/components/galleries/**`
imports Storybook stories from SDK source by relative path
(`../../../../web-sdk/placements/slots/*.stories`). Following those imports
drags web-sdk source into this program, which fails for two reasons that are
about the program shape, not about the code being wrong:
1. the stories import `@storybook/react-vite`, which is not declared as a
dependency anywhere in this repo and is absent from the lockfile;
2. compiling web-sdk source alongside the published `@revturbine/sdk`
.d.ts puts two structurally identical `RevTurbine` global declarations
in one program, which is a hard TS2717 conflict.
Installing Storybook would not fix (2). Both are real and both are tracked
separately — see the PR body. Vite resolves these at build time, so the
gallery pages themselves render; what is missing is a type gate over them.
